title: Pasajes espurios del Nuevo Testamento
author: Constantin von Tischendorf
description: Notas sobre pasajes considerados espurios del Nuevo Testamento griego.

7.6: that being dead (should read "being dead to that")

11.6: But if it be of works, then it is no more grace; otherwise work is no more work

14.6: and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it
